content.body:
The Bf 109F series was an improved model over the earlier 109E series. It boasted a higher climb rate and top speed. It lost the the 20 mm cannons from the wings (improving its roll rate) but a single 20 mm cannon was mounted through the "V" of the engine cylinders. Extra wingspan improved its sustained turn rate but being a little heavier it couldn't pull as tightly into the instantaneous part of the turn compared to the lighter E model.
This aircraft is sometimes referred to as the "Franz" for the "F" model designation.
content.brief: TYPE: Fighter Interceptor MAX. SPEED: 601 km/h WEIGHT: 2,665 kg CREW: 1 ARMAMENT: 20 mm MGFF/M Cannon (1) 7.92 mm MG17 LMGs (2)
